atlassian.description: Connects to Atlassian cloud over HTTP. Gives agents access to Jira projects, issues, and Confluence pages — used by planner to pull ticket context and by swe to link implementations back to tickets.

serena.description: Launches Serena via uv run --frozen (using the committed uv.lock) for symbol-aware code navigation — find definitions, references, and call graphs without scanning every file. The claude-code context disables tools already covered by Claude Code built-ins.

playwright.description: Launches the Playwright MCP server so agents can drive a real browser — navigate pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, and read console output for UI verification.
